newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close higher, seen testing 1,120.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close higher, seen testing 1,120.

text.p: Austrian shares soared to their highest level in 16 weeks, correcting Wednesday's last-minute losses as an overnight record on Wall Street lent a helping hand to bourses across Europe.
Traders said the market was likely to extend its gain over the next few days once Friday's options and futures expiry was out of the way.
With the underlying tone remaining friendly, the 21-share ATX was likely to break through 1,100 points, before running into strong resistance at around 1,200, they said.
The ATX closed 16.26 points or 1.5 percent higher at 1,089.8. Among its constituents, eleven gainers outnumbered ten decliners.
"Tomorrow is a special day, but then we'll go on to approach 1,120," a trader said.
Austro-Italian insurer EA-Generali, one of Wednesday's top decliners in what traders described as a technical sell-off, led the day's gainers and rebounded 5.8 percent to 3,185.0.
VA Stahl and market heavyweight OMV also recovered from steep last-minute losses on Wednesday, adding 5.7 percent and 4.2 percent to close at 370.0 schillings and 1,105.0 respectively.
Carton board maker Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG was the day's top decliner, falling five schillings or one percent to close at 518.0, its lowest level in a month.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index rose 5.01 points or 1.22 percent to finish at 416.34.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX futures for October delivery rose 2.1 points to 1,086.9. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
